bullets: • SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund carries an exit load of 0%, meaning no exit load fee is charged upon redemption after the mandatory 3-year lock-in period has been completed.
• The 3-year lock-in period in SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund effectively restricts early redemption, making the exit load structure straightforward — no fee applies once the lock-in is served.
• SBI Large Cap Fund Direct Plan carries an expense ratio typically in the range of 0.5–0.9% per annum, which is deducted from the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV) on an ongoing basis.
• Regular plans of SBI Mutual Fund schemes carry a higher expense ratio compared to direct plans, as they include distributor commission embedded within the Total Expense Ratio (TER).
• Securities Transaction Tax (STT) of 0.001% is applicable on equity mutual fund redemptions, which is a government-mandated tax separate from the fund's exit load or expense ratio.
• SEBI mandates full disclosure of the Total Expense Ratio (TER) for all mutual fund schemes, ensuring transparency for investors regarding all applicable charges.
